subject: afi-2
title: AFI(2)------SOC.RT.DY.
description: Chart on book p. 395 (JR-17). AFI-2 (affinity insight—second degree) is the subject; SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: POL-DY (political dynamics), RT-INT-TR (reality initiative traits) and INFO-AF-B (information affinity basis). From POL-DY: EXP-DY (expansion dynamics). From EXP-DY: POL-P (political policies) and IF-ST-DY (infra-structure dynamics). From RT-INT-TR: MOT-DY. From MOT-DY: PART (participation). From INFO-AF-B: JR-DY (journalism dynamics). The page text begins: "I have not meant to imply that there has been no significant creativity utilizing the affinity insight (2) principle".
